_comment: FOUNDER ACTION: merge the `hooks` key below into .claude/settings.json (create the file if absent). Claude cannot self-install hook config — arming these is a deliberately founder-owned switch. Two PreToolUse hooks: (1) premerge_hook (ADR-037 Block C) — pre-merge tripwire defense-in-depth over the runner's classify step; (2) role_scope_hook (chip task_dd666049 / 01.8c SECURE-P2) — enforces each read-only/gate subagent's tools-allowlist.md path+mutation scope via the payload `agent_type` (fail-open for the main agent/implementers, fail-closed on a restricted role's Write scope). Both resolve their script path relative to cwd — run shell tools from the repo root (or a dir with the delegating shim); see docs/runbooks/role-scope-hook.md.
